name: ncurses-6.5
purpose: The terminfo database in the .NET install (plan step C1.3): System.Console on Unix reads the TERM entry's capabilities, cursor and color sequences among them, from /usr/share/terminfo, and PSReadLine needs them; ncurses's misc/terminfo.src from the release's tarball by its SHA-256, compiled on the Linux host by tic into the entries xterm-256color, xterm and vt100, as a distribution's ncurses-base package compiles them, with TERM=xterm-256color in the process environment. Never a system copy of terminfo.
